sourceSentences: Quickdraw resets Graves' basic attack timer.

Graves dashes to the target location, reloading one shell while generating a stack of True Grit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 8 times. Dashing towards an enemy champion generates 2 stacks of True Grit.
Quickdraw's current cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds for every pellet impacting an enemy.
If Graves dashes while reloading, he can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
Graves gains the one additional stack of True Grit from Quickdraw if at any point during the dash a visible enemy champion is in front of Graves within 1300 distance.
Basic attack resets other than Quickdraw do not affect Graves' basic attack timer.
Non-champion units hit by more than one pellet are knocked back, though not through terrain.
After 2 seconds, or upon colliding with terrain, the round detonates to deal physical damage to enemies within a wide perpendicular area and in a reverse wave along the powder trail.
Wind Wall will destroy the projectile entirely and mitigate all effects, including the trail on the ground.
Unbreakable is considered to be terrain for the purposes of the projectile, triggering its second effect.
Crowd control immunity and cleanses have no effect on the user's sight radius reduction despite the nearsight being resisted / removed.
Collateral Damage is not disabled while grounded or rooted, but Graves will not dash after the cast time while affected by them.
Graves will not dash after the cast time if he is airborne.
Start with an out attack and press C immediately after and finish this combo with two more out attacks.
if you use both of your bullets and you E and Q at the same time, you can actually hide your Q animation.
But if you're in reload animation, you can actually extend your Q range with this and actually hide your Q animation on top of that.
let's make his queue hit this wall. You see it's much faster.
press W out attack. E out attack. U attack. This is your ball combo. So once again, W out attack, E out attack, Q out attack.
So your combo is WQ auto attack, E out attack with auto out attack.
For combos, start with W to attack. From here E to attack and Q to Alt and attack away.
And your explosive combo is simply attacking with W, Q, and Alt before E returns to them and attacks away.
Additionally, non- champions hit by this are knocked back, allowing him to easily launch kites at jungle monsters.
